title: Map
description: A battlefield: a character grid plus named markers and zones. One character per tile — '.' open, '1'/'2'/'3' cover levels (light/heavy/garrison), '#' blocked building. Authorable in a text editor on purpose: maps are the scatter-prop and sightline budget of a mission, and contributors should be able to sketch one without tooling. The loader (packages/data parseMap) additionally checks that row counts and lengths match the declared dimensions and that markers/zones are in bounds.

items.description: One character per tile. Terrain: "." open, "1"-"3" cover levels. Buildings: "#" concrete, "h" house, "a" apartment, "w" warehouse, "s" shanty, "m" mosque — a contiguous run of identical building symbols is one structure (see data/structures.json).

markers.description: Named points missions reference: spawn anchors, tunnel mouths, HVT positions.

zones.description: Named rects [x, y, w, h]: objective areas, trigger regions, no-fire zones.
